How renting works

  1. 1

    Explore the collection

    Browse cholis, sarees and gowns and save the looks you like.

  2. 2

    Choose your favourite

    Open any outfit to see details and colours.

  3. 3

    Message us on WhatsApp

    We confirm rental price, availability, sizing and your rental dates.

  4. 4

    Visit the studio

    Come to Nikol to see the outfit and complete your rental arrangements.

A booking is not confirmed until the studio confirms it with you.

A local home for ethnic-wear rentals

Saiyar Ethnic Studio is a women's ethnic-wear rental studio in Nikol, Ahmedabad, for anyone who wants to dress beautifully for the occasions that matter, without buying an outfit she may wear once.
